hypothesis: Scaling the parent's successful locality coefficient from 2.0 to 4.0 (x2) strengthens the only mechanism shown to pay off, pushing more adjacent critical pairs onto the same tier and thus lowering crit_cross further, at the cost of a slightly weaker cut term relative to the total.
analysis: (1) Partially: crit_cross fell on C1 (0.011→0.005) and C3 (0.069→0.051), but C2 was already 0.000, so the mechanism had no headroom there; total gain is dominated by C1. C3 improved TNS but WNS regressed (-3.2%). (3) No: seed_std=0.067 and robust=-0.005 mean the mean gain is within noise; C2/C3 per-seed include negatives.
